races.name: Find Us At fitzdares.com Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners_data.name: Beau Jardine
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won twice at course and distance, 132 days off but proven fresh performer with 7lb claimer
runners_data.comment: Last two wins have come over C&D, but losing run up to 24; soft ground suits him best
runners_data.spotlight: Last two wins have come over C&D and he is 13lb lower than for the latest in May 2024 (0-24 since); has won fresh in the past and has run well on good to firm ground, but a softer surface suits him better.

runners_data.name: Moonhall Lass
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good current form, only 5 days since last run and has won for current connections
runners_data.comment: Got off the mark at Yarmouth on Tuesday; 5lb penalty may not stop her under in-form rider
runners_data.spotlight: 0-22 in Ireland, but has done well since joining James Owen, finishing a close third of seven at Southwell (6f, AW) last month (form worked out well) before getting off the mark at Yarmouth (6f, good) on Tuesday; 5lb penalty may not stop her, especially with Henry Callan's record this year reading 3112116114.

runners_data.name: Rovinia
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse mainly seen on all-weather but placed in all three turf starts, needs luck in running
runners_data.comment: Placed in all three starts on turf; will need to improve on his Southwell reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Mainly seen on the AW (1-8), but placed in all three starts on turf; has the assistance of one of the more experienced riders, but will need to improve on this month's Southwell (7f, AW) reappearance.

runners_data.name: Unico
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who may need the run after 134 days off but has experienced amateur jockey Simon Walker
runners_data.comment: Simon Walker a positive, but may be better for the run after 134 days off
runners_data.spotlight: Just 1lb higher than when winning at Brighton (5f, soft) last September (has won on good to firm); Simon Walker a positive, but may be better for the run after 134 days off.

runners_data.name: Roman Spring
runners_data.note: Front-running style with 152 days off but has 7lb claimer and won three times last year when fresh
runners_data.comment: Successful three times last year; may just need this after five months off
runners_data.spotlight: It took him a long time to get off the mark but he was successful three times last year; goes on any ground, but may just need this after five months off; stable also runs Beau Jardine.

runners_data.name: Sub Thirteen
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who is course winner over 5f, has experienced amateur but prefers softer ground
runners_data.comment: 1lb below his last winning mark but could really do with rain
runners_data.spotlight: Course winner over 5f, but stays 6f well; 1lb below his last winning mark and has the assistance of an experienced amateur, but he could really do with rain.

runners_data.name: Conquest Of Power
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse rarely seen on turf with inexperienced 7lb claimer having first ride in Britain
runners_data.comment: Has dropped 8lb below his last winning mark so could play a part if producing his best
runners_data.spotlight: Rarely seen on turf these days even though he has won on it; only one piece of recent worthwhile form and jockey (who also owns him) is having her first ride in public; has dropped 8lb below his last winning mark, though, so could play a part if producing his best.

runners_data.name: Alyara
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare on losing run of 26 races, recent efforts respectable but needs significant improvement
runners_data.comment: Seen more often on the AW these days; latest efforts respectable but losing run up to 26
runners_data.spotlight: Two of her three wins have come on turf, but seen much more often on the AW these days; latest efforts have been respectable, but a losing run of 26 sounds a note of caution.

races.paceDynamic: Roman Spring is the clear early speed horse and will take them along from the start, with Beau Jardine likely to track in second early. With only one genuine front-runner, Roman Spring can dictate terms without pressure and set a manageable gallop over this sharp 6f trip. The majority field comprises hold-up horses (Moonhall Lass, Rovinia, Unico, Sub Thirteen, Conquest Of Power, Alyara) who will need to find racing room in the final 2f. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with early pace, as the hold-up brigade will face a traffic problem in a small field where the leader sets his own tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Roman Spring gets an easy lead and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: Roman Spring faces no early pressure and can quicken off steady fractions, while the packed hold-up horses get in each other's way. The experienced pace-setter capitalizes on perfect positioning despite his layoff.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses find clear runs and Roman Spring weakens
scenarios.body: Moonhall Lass or Unico produce strong finishing kicks when gaps appear in the straight. Their class advantage tells despite the tactical disadvantage of racing from behind the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Beau Jardine travels well and kicks clear approaching the line
scenarios.body: Beau Jardine uses his course and distance wins to perfection, stalking Roman Spring before taking over in the final furlong. His sharp finishing speed suits the track configuration and trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Hold-Up Winner
scenarios.trigger: If Sub Thirteen or Rovinia find dream runs through gaps
scenarios.body: The experienced amateur jockeys thread their mounts through traffic to deliver late challenges that catch the early leaders. Course knowledge and tactical riding overcome the pace disadvantage.

watchPoints.text: Watch Roman Spring's jumping from the stalls as he needs to establish his lead early with no other pace in the race
Watch for traffic problems in the straight as six hold-up horses will be looking for the same gaps simultaneously
Watch Beau Jardine's position turning for home as he needs to be within striking distance to use his finishing kick
Watch the ground conditions as Sub Thirteen specifically needs softer conditions than the good to firm going
Watch the amateur jockeys' tactical awareness as several have limited experience in competitive handicaps

races.name: Fitzdares Fillies' Conditions Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Babzini
runners_data.comment: Stable can get them ready first time, but she may appreciate further in due course
runners_data.spotlight: March foal by St Mark's Basilica; 100,000gns yearling; dam 7.6f winner (RPR 82), sister to UAE 1m1f Group 2 winner Valiant Prince, half-sister to 1m4f Group 3 winner Klassique, out of 1m Group 1 winner; stable can get them ready first time, but she may appreciate further in due course.

runners_data.name: Nonrem
runners_data.comment: Bred for speed, but stable's 2yo newcomers are usually better for a run
runners_data.spotlight: February foal by Oasis Dream; £50,000 yearling; closely related to 6f 2yo winner Apache Green (RPR 79); dam unraced half-sister to Breeders' Cup Turf Sprint winner Belvoir Bay, out of 1m winner; bred for speed, but stable's 2yo newcomers are usually better for a run.

runners_data.name: Rhodes Runner
runners_data.comment: Bred to stay further but the stable has made a bright start to the season with its 2yos
runners_data.spotlight: March foal by Minzaal; 75,000gns yearling; dam maiden half-sister to winners Sumiha (1m4f Group 3) and Suwayra (1m 2yo), out of Group-placed 1m2f winning half-sister to 1m Group 3 winner Sinawann; bred to stay further but the stable has made a bright start to the season with its 2yos; respected.

runners_data.name: Ziggy Starshine
runners_data.comment: Won with more in hand than margin would suggest on Bath debut: form franked; major player
runners_data.spotlight: Landed quite a gamble when making a successful debut at Bath (5f, good; 15-8) 16 days ago, beating a subsequent winner with a lot more in hand than the neck margin would suggest; major player.

runners_data.name: Lover Girl
runners_data.comment: Made a winning debut at Wolverhampton; form has been franked, but this looks harder
runners_data.spotlight: Overcame the outside stall when making a winning debut at Wolverhampton (5f, AW; 11-2) this month; the form has been franked, but this looks harder.

runners_data.name: Passerine
runners_data.comment: Fourth behind Ziggy Starshine on Bath debut; open to improvement but it will be needed
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off 7-1 when beaten just over 4l into fourth of 13 behind Ziggy Starshine at Bath (5f, good) 16 days ago; 5lb better off and open to improvement, but it will be needed.

races.name: Track Radio Launches Tomorrow Handicap

runners_data.name: Em Four
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse faces a tactical disadvantage in a small field with one front runner, but has the class edge with highest RPR rating
runners_data.comment: Career-best RPR dropped to 5f at Wolverhampton 12 days ago, making all; needs more up 6lb
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice on turf last year (as well as once on AW) and he has continued on an upward curve in 2026, winning for the third time this season when making all at Wolverhampton 12 days ago; that was his first success at this trip and there could be more to come at 5f; 6lb rise demands progress though.

runners_data.name: Over Spiced
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with significant weight advantage (18lbs less than topweight) and strong recent turf form including three wins

runners_data.name: Jax Edge
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the race shape but disappointed badly last time and has never won off this high a mark
runners_data.comment: Dropped right away on recent return to action (5.7f, good); needs to leave that behind
runners_data.spotlight: Dropped right away at Bath (5.7f, good) on her reappearance 16 days ago; can win more races this year but she is yet to defy a mark this high and there are in-form opponents.

runners_data.name: Ziggy's Missile
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning to turf where he has limited success, mainly an all-weather performer
runners_data.comment: Most success on AW but has won on turf; sharper for recent reappearance; dangerous mark
runners_data.spotlight: Most of his success has come on AW but he showed at Nottingham last spring that he could get the job done on turf (5f, good); looked as though his recent seasonal return would bring him on and his lacklustre end to 2025 has seen him drop to a dangerous mark.

runners_data.name: Dapper Valley
runners_data.note: Front runner carries topweight but gets the ideal tactical scenario with no pace pressure expected
runners_data.comment: Returned to Britain off a reduced mark & won easily at Leicester 8 days ago; 5f a slight ?
runners_data.spotlight: Quickly coaxed back to form by James Owen last year, winning 6f handicaps at Kempton (twice) and Chester; struggled on dirt in the Middle East over the winter but his mark dropped quickly and he ran well back on turf in Abu Dhabi in March; returned to Britain with an emphatic success at Leicester (6f, good to firm) eight days ago; today's 8lb higher mark should still be in range but the drop to 5f is a slight query.

races.paceDynamic: Dapper Valley will likely take the field along from the front with Over Spiced, Jax Edge and Ziggy's Missile all sitting prominently behind him in this small field. With only one confirmed front runner, the early pace should be sustainable rather than frantic, allowing Dapper Valley to dictate terms without serious pressure. The modest gallop will suit horses who can track the pace and have a sustained finish, but may leave Em Four with too much ground to make up from his hold-up position. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close to the pace and finish off the moderate tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Dapper Valley leads uncontested and maintains his gallop to the line
scenarios.body: The front runner gets first run on his rivals and the moderate pace doesn't set up a strong finish from behind. Prominent trackers get their chance but the leader has done enough.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady enough for a well-positioned closer to pick up the pieces
scenarios.body: Over Spiced or Jax Edge can sit in Dapper Valley's slipstream before producing a sustained challenge in the final furlong. The reduced weight gives Over Spiced a significant advantage over the front runner.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes slower than expected and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Em Four gets the tactical scenario he needs with a dawdling pace that sets up his closing kick. His proven ability and highest RPR rating tells as the race becomes a pure speed test in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Dapper Valley goes too fast early or the prominent horses engage too soon
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable and allows a horse from further back to sweep past tiring leaders. Ziggy's Missile or Em Four benefit from the tactical meltdown up front.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Dapper Valley goes off too fast early as he could set this up for the closers behind
Watch Over Spiced's early positioning as her 13lb weight pull gives her a significant advantage if she can sit handy
Watch Em Four's early position as he needs the pace to be stronger than expected to get into contention
Watch for any market moves on Jax Edge despite her poor recent run as the prominent style suits perfectly
Watch the pace through the first two furlongs as this will determine whether hold-up horses get involved

races.name: Download The Fitzdares App Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Binmalk
runners_data.comment: Makes plenty of appeal on breeding and stable has a fine record with 3yo newcomers
runners_data.spotlight: First foal; dam Listed-placed 7f 2yo/1m AW winner (RPR 106), sister to winners Benbatl (1m1f/1m2f Group 1) and Modaara (useful 1m2f/1m4f), half-sister to 1,000 Guineas winner Elmalka (by Kingman), out of 1m2f Group 1/Grade 1 winner; makes plenty of appeal on breeding and stable has a fine record with 3yo newcomers.

runners_data.name: Guitar Solo
runners_data.comment: Enough in her pedigree to make her worth monitoring in the market
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to winners Finest Sound (Group placed 7f-1m2f including Saudi Arabia; RPR 114) and Megaphone (5f/6f AW; 83); dam unraced sister to Qatari 1m-1m2f winner Seema, out of unraced close relative of Grand Prix de Paris/St Leger winner Scorpion; enough in her pedigree to make her worth monitoring in the market.

runners_data.name: Seven Sisters
runners_data.comment: Highly attractive pedigree and stable has won this race twice since 2019
runners_data.spotlight: 475,000gns yearling; half-sister to five winners including Barney Roy (7f-1m4f including 2yo/Group 1; RPR 124), Noble Dynasty (7f/1m including 2yo/AW/Group 3; 118), Wisdom Mind (1m; 98) and Arabian Tribe (8.6f AW 2yo; 89); dam maiden (71), out of 7f/1m Group 3 winner; highly attractive pedigree and stable has won this race (or a division of it) twice since 2019, including with a newcomer.

runners_data.name: Storming Point
runners_data.comment: Beaten a short head on Newbury debut in October; respected despite likely different ground
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off 15-2 when beaten a short head by a stablemate of Poetry Of Time on his Newbury debut (6.5f, soft) in October; the ground here is likely to be different, but that was still a promising start; respected.

runners_data.name: Dream Camp
runners_data.comment: Definite promise when fifth on his Kempton debut in December; bred to do better
runners_data.spotlight: 250,000euros yearling; showed definite promise when fifth of 13 on his Kempton debut (7f, AW; 13-2) in December; bred to do better and worth considering, especially if the market is positive.

runners_data.name: The Bureau Club
runners_data.comment: Fourth in both starts over 1m on AW; drop in trip may not be ideal, but still shortlisted
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth in both starts over 1m on the AW with the form of her latest Kempton performance having since received a few boosts; the drop in trip may not be completely ideal, but she still makes the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Tass
runners_data.comment: Not much promise in two starts over 6f on the AW; looks more one for handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Not much promise in his first two starts over 6f on the AW; looks more one for handicaps after this.

races.name: Call Fitzdares For Top Prices Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Princess Rascal
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with C&D form but 191 days off and needs to overcome strong early pace from poor tactical position
runners_data.comment: Two 1m2f wins last year, including here; still has potential after just six starts; chance
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner (good to firm) last May on her second start; ran well in all three handicaps over this trip (flopped over 1m4f) afterwards, winning at Newmarket in October off 6lb lower; she will need to improve again to defy this mark but after just six starts it is not out of the question.

runners_data.name: Typical Woman
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with proven stamina but aging mare returning from soft ground failure needs to find best form
runners_data.comment: Low-key return at Pontefract last month; vulnerable to improvers
runners_data.spotlight: Ended her 2025 campaign with a 1m1f win at Lingfield (good to firm); never in the hunt on last month's return to action at Pontefract (1m, good to soft); vulnerable to improvers.

runners_data.name: Dreamasar
runners_data.note: Front runner with 209 days absence but strong breeding for trip and proven ability to lead successfully
runners_data.comment: Three promising runs at 1m as a 2yo; opening mark looks well in range and 1m2f should suit
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to Group 1 winner Dreamloper; off the mark at the second attempt in 1m Lingfield maiden (AW) in September and backed it up with a good fourth under a penalty in 1m Yarmouth novice following month (race worked out well); has plenty more to offer now handicapping over this longer distance; has been a non-runner on account of good to firm and soft ground in the past.

runners_data.name: Siam Ruby
runners_data.note: Natural front runner in good recent form but limited turf experience against stronger opposition than faced before
runners_data.comment: Two AW wins in small fields; ran well on sole turf outing; still has untapped potential
runners_data.spotlight: The winner of two of her four starts, namely front-running efforts in small fields at Lingfield (1m2f) and Wolverhampton (9.4f); her only turf outing saw her make a bold bid at Doncaster (1m2f, good to soft) in March; up 4lb for the latest win but she appeals as having more in the tank.

runners_data.name: Plaid
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner stepping up in trip with Hollie Doyle booking suggesting confidence in stamina lasting
runners_data.comment: Promise in three runs at around 1m; any improvement for 1m2f will see her bang there
runners_data.spotlight: Plenty of speed on the bottom line of her pedigree but she is by Ghaiyyath and her races at around 1m have suggested this new, longer trip should be in range; up 2lb for a narrow defeat at Kempton five weeks ago but still a major player.

runners_data.name: Royal Poetry
runners_data.note: Front runner who made all last time but that was in weak company and faces much stronger pace pressure here
runners_data.comment: Made all in steadily-run 4-runner novice last month; unexposed but improvement essential
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the third attempt when making all in a steadily-run 8.6f fillies' novice at Wolverhampton last month; likely the runner-up underperformed on that occasion and the handicapper doesn't appear to have taken any chances; that said, she's an unexposed and well-bred filly who could benefit from today's step up in trip.

races.paceDynamic: Dreamasar, Royal Poetry, and Siam Ruby will ensure a strong gallop from the start with all three confirmed front runners unlikely to yield. The sustained pace over 1m2f on good to firm ground will create a searching test of stamina, particularly through Salisbury's undulating terrain. Princess Rascal and Typical Woman will need to overcome tactical disadvantages from their hold-up styles. This pace setup clearly favors prominent racers who can sit close enough to avoid being strung out but won't get embroiled in the early speed battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too hard early and crack in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will stretch the field and allow hold-up horses to pick up the pieces late. Typical Woman's stamina and Princess Rascal's class will shine through when the pace setters tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace setters can steal a march and dictate more sensible fractions
scenarios.body: Siam Ruby or Royal Poetry could use their early speed to control the race and maintain enough for the finish. The others will struggle to reel in a controlled front runner over this trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders mark each other closely and allow a more tactical race to develop
scenarios.body: The pace will be more stop-start, suiting horses that can quicken rather than stay. Plaid's speed and Princess Rascal's class become more relevant in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Survival
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders maintain their positions and create an extreme gallop throughout
scenarios.body: Only the most genuine stayers will be in contention, with Typical Woman's proven stamina and Dreamasar's breeding coming to the fore. The pace will be unsustainable for most.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Dreamasar and Royal Poetry can handle the long absence and stronger pace pressure after easy previous wins
Monitor how Typical Woman travels early - if struggling to stay in touch the strong pace will finish her chances completely
Observe Princess Rascal's early positioning - needs to be closer than usual style suggests to cope with the strong gallop
Check if Siam Ruby can maintain her front running style when challenged by two other confirmed pace setters
Watch Plaid's response to the step up in trip - breeding suggests stamina questions at this distance for the first time

races.name: Fitzdares Extra Places Every Day EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Scarlet Legend
runners_data.note: Hold-up style debutant with Goodwood Cup winner brother Quickthorn, trained by in-form Balding stable
runners_data.comment: Brother to owner's Goodwood Cup winner Quickthorn; makes debut today
runners_data.spotlight: Eighth foal; brother to owner's Goodwood Cup winner Quickthorn, half-brother to five other winners (two useful); dam 7f-1m2f winner (RPR; 74); riding arrangements suggest Spirit Dreamer may be the stable's main hope.

runners_data.name: Spirit Dreamer
runners_data.note: Second Balding debutant with hold-up style, closely related to 1m4f winner Princess Rabab
runners_data.comment: Out of a sister to an Australian 1m Group 3 winner; market helpful before debut
runners_data.spotlight: 52,000euros yearling; third foal; closely related to 1m4f AW winner Princess Rabab (RPR 67), half-brother to 1m4f winner Ancient Myth (81); dam 1m winner (77), sister to an Australian 1m Group 3 winner; market helpful.

runners_data.name: Outflank
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who ran respectable third on Salisbury debut, 137 days off but Gosden stable handles breaks well
runners_data.comment: Has good pedigree and made promising debut on AW in December; can improve
runners_data.spotlight: 750,000gns yearling; brother to a Hong Kong Group 3 winner and closely related to 2,000 Guineas third Royal Scotsman; kept on for respectable third of five on debut at Kempton (1m3f, AW: winner looks smart) in December and has obvious scope for progress this year.

runners_data.name: Last Trump
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who shaped with promise on Newbury debut before fading, step up to 1m4f should suit
runners_data.comment: Shaped with clear promise when fifth in valuable 1m3f Newbury maiden last month
runners_data.spotlight: 80-1 for valuable Newbury maiden (1m3f, good) on debut a fortnight ago but shaped with significant promise before fading into fifth; has big role to play here if able to build on that performance.

runners_data.name: Ranga Tang
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner with most experience, game third at Newmarket over 1m2f on similar going
runners_data.comment: Close third in Class 3 Newmarket handicap last month (1m2f); sets useful standard
runners_data.spotlight: The most exposed runner in the line-up, having run four times, but ran game race from the front when close third in Class 3 Newmarket handicap (1m2f, good; first-time cheekpieces) on last month's seasonal debut, and sets a useful standard back in a maiden; moves up in trip; headgear removed.

runners_data.name: Surrey King
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but concerning tendency to fade in finish, 191 days since poor Newbury debut
runners_data.comment: 25-1, lost many lengths at the start and was always behind on debut in October (1m)
runners_data.spotlight: Out of a 1m4f Group 3 winner; 25-1, lost many lengths at the start and was always behind on debut at Newbury (1m, soft) in October.

runners_data.name: Semper Femina
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who finished well for second on Kempton debut, 5lb claim for Joe Leavy valuable
runners_data.comment: Finished well for second on debut and ran better than bare form suggests last time
runners_data.spotlight: Made promising debut at Kempton (1m3f, AW) in March, finishing well to take second, and arguably ran quite a bit better than eventual 13l defeat suggests when ninth at Newbury (1m2f, good) last month; holds each-way claims at least here.

runners_data.name: Shirakawa
runners_data.note: Prominent style, bettered debut effort last time but weakened in final furlong over 1m3f
runners_data.comment: Ran well for a long way at Kempton last month needs another big step forward here
runners_data.spotlight: Bettered low-key 2yo debut when seventh at Kempton (1m3f, AW) last month, where she ran well for a long way before weakening inside final furlong; finished behind Semper Femina there, though, and needs another big step forward here.

runners_data.name: Sir Griflet
runners_data.note: Prominent early but struggled on both recent outings, good pedigree but poor form suggests watching brief
runners_data.comment: Has good pedigree but struggled on both outings last month
runners_data.spotlight: Has good pedigree but struggled on both outings last month (1m3f/1m2f) and can only be watched here.

races.paceDynamic: Ranga Tang will take this field along at a controlled gallop, with no serious pace pressure from the small field. Outflank and Shirakawa may sit handy but neither appears keen to challenge for the early lead. The modest pace will set up a sprint finish from the final three furlongs, allowing hold-up horses like Last Trump, Semper Femina, and the debutants Scarlet Legend and Spirit Dreamer to close strongly. This race shape clearly favours horses with finishing kicks who can settle and deliver late pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Classy Debutants Deliver
scenarios.trigger: If either Scarlet Legend or Spirit Dreamer shows the class suggested by their breeding and Balding stable
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace allows them to settle before unleashing superior finishing speed in the final two furlongs. Balding's 19% strike-rate with newcomers combines with excellent pedigrees to overcome their debut disadvantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Last Trump Fulfills Promise
scenarios.trigger: If Last Trump builds on his promising Newbury debut where he shaped well before fading
scenarios.body: The extra two furlongs and controlled pace suit his hold-up style perfectly after showing ability over 1m3f. His late fade at Newbury suggests the step up in trip is exactly what he needs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Ranga Tang gets an easy lead and the pace stays very modest throughout
scenarios.body: His proven stamina over 1m2f-1m4f and game front-running style could see him resist late challenges if not pressed early. The relatively weak field may lack the pace to reel him in despite the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Exposed Form Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a truly-run affair where experience trumps potential
scenarios.body: Outflank's Group-class breeding and respectable Salisbury third gives him an edge over less-exposed rivals. His prominent style allows him to track the pace and quicken when the real racing begins.

watchPoints.text: Ranga Tang could steal this if he gets an uncontested lead and the pace stays very modest throughout
Surrey King showed very poor debut form and has concerning pattern of fading in finish
Last Trump's debut effort suggests significant improvement likely with step up to 1m4f
Both Balding debutants merit close attention given trainer's 19% strike-rate with newcomers
Semper Femina ran well on debut but ninth of 10 last time at Kempton suggests form decline

races.name: Fitzdares Handicap

runners_data.name: Calshot Spit
runners_data.note: Only natural front runner returning from 570-day absence, likely to get uncontested lead but fitness concerns evident
runners_data.comment: Ran okay over hurdles last week but needs to be somewhere near best Flat form today
runners_data.spotlight: Dual Flat winner in 2024 (1m5f/2m1f) but raced exclusively over hurdles since autumn of that year; probably only fifth best on merit when third at Fontwell last week and will need to be somewhere close to his best Flat form to overcome current mark.

runners_data.name: Beggarman
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with course experience but 190-day layoff and preference for softer ground counts against
runners_data.comment: Absent since poor run in October but resumes on a workable mark
runners_data.spotlight: Gained last season's two wins on consecutive starts at Ffos Las (1m6f/2m) in the summer; absent since heavy defeat in October and would appeal more on ground slower than good but resumes on a workable mark.

runners_data.name: Laravie
runners_data.note: Prominent runner switching from hurdles with visor applied, only recent run gives fitness edge
runners_data.comment: Has made disappointing start to Flat career this year but is a fairly useful hurdler
runners_data.spotlight: Developed into fairly useful hurdler when fitted with a visor last year, winning four times (2m4f-2m7f); didn't show a great deal in three AW novice races (8.6f-1m3f) in March and was soundly beaten when upped to 2m for recent handicap debut (visor refitted) but she may yet transfer some of that hurdling ability to this code.

runners_data.name: Kotari
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse reverting to Flat from hurdles on attractive mark, strongest recent form of the field
runners_data.comment: Not the force of old but ran well over hurdles in March and returns to Flat on good mark
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to win last year and is patently not as good as he was but he ran well over hurdles in March and reverts to the Flat on a tempting mark; might ideally prefer ground slower than good but still makes appeal.

runners_data.name: Basilette
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning from 600-day break, proven at this level but major fitness concerns
runners_data.comment: Dual hurdle winner in October; back from a break today; first Flat run since 2024
runners_data.spotlight: Won two low-grade handicap hurdles in October; has fitness to prove after six-month absence and this is her first Flat start since September 2024 but she still enters calculations off a career-low mark.

runners_data.name: Take The Boat
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with AW form translating to turf debut, apprentice rider takes 7lbs off
runners_data.comment: In good form on AW in recent months; now needs to prove herself on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Came good for current stable at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) in February and has made the frame on three of her four AW starts since; could have untapped potential over staying trips but needs to prove herself on turf.

runners_data.name: Sneaky Blinder
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with inconsistent turf record, headgear changes suggest connections seeking improvement
runners_data.comment: As good as ever on AW two starts ago but has modest strike-rate on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Looked as good as ever when keeping on well for narrow win at Wolverhampton (2m, AW) in March but his latest AW run was disappointing and his turf strike-rate is modest (1-15); others preferred.

runners_data.name: High Favour
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden with poor recent form, warning sign of fading in finish makes avoidable
runners_data.comment: Down the field in AW handicaps on all four starts for current stable and now 0-7 overall
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who finished down the field in AW handicaps (1m4f-2m) on all four starts for current stable since December; can't be recommended on this switch back to turf.

runners_data.name: Golden Samba
runners_data.note: Hold-up type lightly raced over this trip, 5lb apprentice claim helps competitive handicap mark
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced; made low-key return in April but was placed on handicap debut in September
runners_data.spotlight: Made low-key seasonal reappearance on Tapeta last month but was placed on handicap debut at Bath (1m6f, soft) in September and remains lightly raced; could have a say if suited by today's much faster ground.

races.paceDynamic: Calshot Spit looks the only natural pace-setter in this small field, with Laravie potentially pressing but more likely to settle just behind. The moderate early gallop will suit the large contingent of hold-up horses including Kotari, Beggarman, Take The Boat, Sneaky Blinder and Golden Samba, who will be looking to pounce late. With so many horses needing to come from behind and only one confirmed leader, this sets up as a tactical affair that will likely develop into a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as they'll have every chance to get competitive from the rear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Calshot Spit sets a steady pace and the field bunches up approaching the final three furlongs
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the back with multiple hold-up horses launching bids simultaneously. Kotari and Take The Boat, both proven over this trip with strong finishing kicks, are best equipped to capitalize on this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Calshot Spit gets an easy lead and quickens turning for home before the closers can respond
scenarios.body: Despite being outrated, the front runner's fitness edge from recent hurdles action tells as the field struggles to peg back the leader. Calshot Spit holds on with Laravie best placed to chase from a prominent position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improved Hold-Up Winner
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced horses has improved significantly and produces a decisive late surge
scenarios.body: Golden Samba or Basilette, returning from breaks with untapped potential, unleashes a powerful finish that catches the more exposed runners. Their fresher profiles and lower weights become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Experience Trumps Class
scenarios.trigger: If the testing conditions and tactical nature expose the younger or less experienced runners
scenarios.body: Beggarman's course experience and proven stamina at this trip sees him grind out victory in a war of attrition. The veteran's racecraft becomes the difference as others falter in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Calshot Spit's fitness after 570-day absence - if sweating up or showing signs of a hard race early, the pace scenario changes completely
Take The Boat's turf debut with 7lb apprentice - market support would suggest connections confident about surface switch
Kotari's settling ability early on - his hold-up style needs to overcome the tactical pace to be effective
Any late market moves for Golden Samba or Basilette - both have scope for improvement despite long absences
How aggressively Laravie races in prominent position - could disrupt the tactical pace if pressing Calshot Spit
